description: F7 rule 8 golden: B4 quote fading (iap.execution.fading; API_TRADING.md section 2.16): book_pressure cases [own, opp]; fade_rule cases; would_have_filled cases on the fixed timeline (states [ts, bid, ask, bid_sz, ask_sz], halts); pull_rows / pull_summary / pull_outcomes over PullRecord rows (PullRecord.to_dict field names). `rows` = pull_rows(pulls, timeline, 0.01, horizons, qty_unit 1, cluster 's1'); `summary` = pull_summary(rows, horizons, lost_race=1); `rows_queue` / `summary_queue` = the queue rules at qty_unit 100, horizons 1s and 5s; `outcomes` = pull_outcomes(pulls, timeline, 0.01, horizons).
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`

slice.rule: a sample is taken after applying the k-th event (1-based) whenever k > prefix_events and k % sample_every == 0
slice.readings_rule: a reading after every 50th event (1-based ordinal) past the prefix whose book is two-sided: ts = the event's exchange_ts, expected_return = (bid_sz - ask_sz) / (bid_sz + ask_sz) * 1e-4 of the consolidated L1 after the event, z = iap.execution.signal.zscore over those expected returns; equal timestamps keep the last reading
slice.timeline_rule: after every event with a two-sided consolidated book: append_state_pinned(ts, best_bid_ticks * tick, best_ask_ticks * tick, bid_sz, ask_sz) (crossed states skipped; no halts)
slice.rules_rule: per sample and side: pressure = book_pressure(own L1 size, opposite L1 size); z = the reading at the sample's exchange_ts; rule_signal = fade_rule(side, z, 1.0, pressure, 0.0); rule_pressure = fade_rule(side, None, 0.0, pressure, 0.6); rule_both = fade_rule(side, z, 0.5, pressure, 0.75)
